items.item_text: Bachelor’s degree in related area and / or equivalent experience / training
Bachelor’s degree in related area and/or equivalent training/experience in a related field.
Five years’ experience working in a highly-confidential environment including maintaining confidentiality of various financial activities and HR records.
Experience in recruitment and employment policies, procedures, and laws, and skills to be an effective resource to hiring managers.
Experience with Aggie Enterprise, Aggie Expense, Aggie Travel, UCPath, and SSO/AUSS-C.

Under the supervision of the Chief Administrative Officer, provide administrative and analytical support for human resources and business operations within the UC Davis Genome Center and its research support cores. Serve as a unit resource for academic and staff personnel matters, providing support, guidance, policy interpretation, and coordination with hiring managers, principal investigators, employees, and campus service units.

Provide operations support with an emphasis on procurement and purchasing activities, documentation, and coordination with campus procurement and supply chain offices. Assist account management team with cost adjustments. Research and resolve routine administrative issues, maintain accurate records, and help ensure personnel and business transactions comply with applicable University policies and procedures.
Organizational and time management skills to manage multiple tasks, prioritize and organize workload, meet deadlines and perform assigned duties with minimal supervision.
Skills to function independently and creatively to research, analyze and coordinate a variety of administrative projects with general guidance and review by supervisory personnel.
Interpersonal and communication skills to work as part of a team with a wide variety of faculty, staff, and external sponsors.
Skills and ability to follow projects to completion, keeping appropriate personnel advised of project status, due dates, etc.
